freshness.warning: Treat unavailable or unknown actor access as unsupported until verified. UI-only capability is not agent-callable by implication.

human_operator.name: Interactive terminal/TUI
human_operator.summary: Terminal-first interface to Antigravity agents with slash commands, Vim mode, and artifact views.

evidence.claim: Terminal-first interface to Antigravity agents with slash commands, Vim mode, and artifact views.

human_operator.name: Desktop or web surface
human_operator.summary: Antigravity CLI shares a backend with the Antigravity desktop command center.

evidence.claim: Antigravity CLI shares a backend with the Antigravity desktop command center.
Invocation verified: Antigravity 2.0 desktop command center (antigravity.google)

human_operator.name: Agent-native file editing
human_operator.summary: Antigravity agents understand codebases and edit files under permission controls.

evidence.claim: Antigravity agents understand codebases and edit files under permission controls.
Invocation verified: write_to_file tool (agent file-edit tool)

human_operator.name: Agent-native shell execution
human_operator.summary: Agents execute shell commands, and users can issue direct commands from the CLI.

evidence.claim: Agents execute shell commands, and users can issue direct commands from the CLI.
Invocation verified: commandExecutionPolicy (agent frontmatter), /permissions command-approval rules

human_operator.name: Headless/non-interactive execution
human_operator.summary: Print mode provides non-interactive execution and direct read-only slash-command queries.

evidence.claim: Print mode provides non-interactive execution and direct read-only slash-command queries.

human_operator.name: Machine-readable output
human_operator.summary: Print mode emits text, JSON, or typed NDJSON `stream-json`, including tool and subagent metadata.

evidence.claim: Print mode emits text, JSON, or typed NDJSON `stream-json`, including tool and subagent metadata.

human_operator.name: Embeddable SDK
human_operator.summary: The Antigravity SDK provides programmatic access to the same platform capabilities.

evidence.claim: The Antigravity SDK provides programmatic access to the same platform capabilities.
Invocation verified: pip install google-antigravity (Antigravity SDK)

human_operator.name: MCP client
human_operator.summary: Antigravity CLI supports MCP tools, progress reporting, OAuth, and admin controls.

evidence.claim: Antigravity CLI supports MCP tools, progress reporting, OAuth, and admin controls.
Invocation verified: /mcp add|remove|list|enable|disable, mcp_config.json

human_operator.name: Agent Skills
human_operator.summary: Agent Skills can be discovered and expanded in interactive and headless print modes.

evidence.claim: Agent Skills can be discovered and expanded in interactive and headless print modes.
Invocation verified: /skills, SKILL.md frontmatter (metadata.icon, disable-slash-command)

human_operator.name: Plugins/extensions
human_operator.summary: Plugins package customizations and share enablement with Antigravity configuration.

evidence.claim: Plugins package customizations and share enablement with Antigravity configuration.
Invocation verified: /plugins, rules.json (plugin-level rules)

human_operator.name: Lifecycle hooks
human_operator.summary: Hooks run before/after invocations and at stop points with explicit ordering.

evidence.claim: Hooks run before/after invocations and at stop points with explicit ordering.

human_operator.name: Hierarchical project instructions
human_operator.summary: Custom agents can be defined in Markdown with frontmatter controlling role, inheritance, and command policy.

evidence.claim: Custom agents can be defined in Markdown with frontmatter controlling role, inheritance, and command policy.
Invocation verified: AGENTS.md, GEMINI.md, .agents/rules/ folder

human_operator.name: Resume, fork, and session lineage
human_operator.summary: Conversations are persistent, can be forked, and warn about concurrent access.

evidence.claim: Conversations are persistent, can be forked, and warn about concurrent access.

human_operator.name: Subagents/delegation
human_operator.summary: Custom and dynamic subagents are first-class and expose child conversation metadata in structured output.

evidence.claim: Custom and dynamic subagents are first-class and expose child conversation metadata in structured output.
Invocation verified: /agents, agent.md (e.g. .agents/agents/{agent_name}/agent.md)

human_operator.name: Parallel/background agents
human_operator.summary: Antigravity orchestrates multiple agents and background tasks without blocking the terminal.

evidence.claim: Antigravity orchestrates multiple agents and background tasks without blocking the terminal.
Invocation verified: /tasks, manage_task tool

human_operator.name: First-class multi-agent coordination
human_operator.summary: The Antigravity backend provides explicit multi-agent orchestration and coordinator/subagent state.

evidence.claim: The Antigravity backend provides explicit multi-agent orchestration and coordinator/subagent state.
Invocation verified: subagent_info payload (stream-json output), mainAgent/subagent frontmatter fields

human_operator.name: Remote/cloud execution
human_operator.summary: CLI and desktop share a unified Antigravity backend for background and multi-workspace work.

evidence.claim: CLI and desktop share a unified Antigravity backend for background and multi-workspace work.

human_operator.name: Scheduled tasks
human_operator.summary: Antigravity projects support scheduled messages/tasks.

evidence.claim: Antigravity projects support scheduled messages/tasks.
Invocation verified: schedule tool (DurationSeconds, MaxIterations), Scheduled Tasks / Cron sidecars (Antigravity 2.0)

human_operator.name: Execution sandbox
human_operator.summary: Terminal execution uses filesystem/network sandboxing and records blocked network requests.

evidence.claim: Terminal execution uses filesystem/network sandboxing and records blocked network requests.
Invocation verified: --sandbox

human_operator.name: Granular permissions and approvals
human_operator.summary: Permission modes, allowlists, project/user settings, and strict review modes govern commands.

evidence.claim: Permission modes, allowlists, project/user settings, and strict review modes govern commands.
Invocation verified: /permissions, regex: prefix in permission rules, ask / always-proceed permission modes

human_operator.name: Usage and cost telemetry
human_operator.summary: Structured output includes token/cache usage; read-only print commands expose usage, quota, credits, model, and effort without an agent turn.

evidence.claim: Structured output includes token/cache usage; read-only print commands expose usage, quota, credits, model, and effort without an agent turn.
Invocation verified: /usage, /quota, /credits, cache_read_tokens (JSON output)

human_operator.name: Agent tracing/event telemetry
human_operator.summary: Typed step, tool, subagent, and terminal result events form a machine-consumable execution trace.

evidence.claim: Typed step, tool, subagent, and terminal result events form a machine-consumable execution trace.
Invocation verified: --output-format stream-json, init/step_update/result events, tool_info / subagent_info payloads

human_operator.name: Web search/research
human_operator.summary: Antigravity supports research through tools and connected MCP knowledge sources.

evidence.claim: Antigravity supports research through tools and connected MCP knowledge sources.
Invocation verified: search_web tool, read_url_content tool

human_operator.name: Browser/computer use
human_operator.summary: Built-in Chrome DevTools MCP and Antigravity integrations support browser workflows.

evidence.claim: Built-in Chrome DevTools MCP and Antigravity integrations support browser workflows.
Invocation verified: built-in Chrome DevTools MCP server (chrome-devtools-mcp)

human_operator.name: Artifacts, diffs, and rich result views
human_operator.summary: Artifact views, diffs, images, comments, and rich desktop panels support result review.

evidence.claim: Artifact views, diffs, images, comments, and rich desktop panels support result review.
Invocation verified: /diff, conversation artifact directory (e.g. scratch/)

human_operator.name: Model and reasoning controls
human_operator.summary: Model and reasoning effort are selectable interactively and through headless flags.

evidence.claim: Model and reasoning effort are selectable interactively and through headless flags.
Invocation verified: --model <slug>, --effort <level>, /model, /effort

human_operator.name: Output schema enforcement
human_operator.summary: `--json-schema` constrains the final structured result in JSON and stream-json modes.

evidence.claim: `--json-schema` constrains the final structured result in JSON and stream-json modes.
